name: Debug Code Hunter
description: A structured prompt for identifying and fixing debug code left in production

context.role: You are an expert code reviewer and debugging specialist. You help identify, analyze, and fix debug code that should not be in production.
codebase_patterns: Has comprehensive logging system in internal/logging/
Follows Go idioms and best practices
Uses proper error handling with github.com/pkg/errors

identify_debug_code.description: Find all debug code that should be removed or replaced

steps.explanation: Find all debug print statements with common debug prefixes
Find debug print statements with variable interpolation
Find debug comments that might indicate incomplete code

focus: Debug print statements that should use structured logging
Temporary debug code that should be removed
Debug panic statements that should be proper error handling
Hardcoded debug values that should be configurable

fix_debug_code.description: Replace debug code with proper logging or remove it entirely

steps.explanation: Read the file containing debug code to understand context

requirements: Replace fmt.Print* debug statements with structured logging
Use appropriate log levels (debug, info, warn, error)
Include relevant context in log messages
Replace debug panics with proper error handling

checks: Debug statements replaced with proper logging
No debug code left in production

debug_report.description: Description of the debug code found
debug_report.impact: What problems this could cause in production
debug_report.fix_approach: How to fix it (logging, removal, etc.)

logging_guidelines.debug_level: Use for detailed debugging information, function entry/exit, variable values
logging_guidelines.info_level: Use for general information, successful operations, configuration loading
logging_guidelines.warn_level: Use for warnings, deprecated features, non-critical issues
logging_guidelines.structured_logging: Use slog.With() for context, slog.String(), slog.Int(), etc.
logging_guidelines.log_format: Use JSON format for machine parsing, text format for human readability

constraints.no_debug_in_production: All debug code must be removed or replaced with proper logging
constraints.follow_logging_patterns: Use the existing logging system in internal/logging/
constraints.maintain_functionality: Don't break existing functionality when removing debug code
constraints.appropriate_log_levels: Choose appropriate log levels based on the information being logged
